text:
Leah (Head of Product): quick post-all-hands follow-up. Leadership, can we agree on a single short timeline + explicit go/no-go gates for three things: API v2 surface, Console GA, and Optimize cost recommendations? partners want firm enough targets to schedule demos and content.

Sophie (CEO): we can share targets but they must be labeled as targets. propose publishing one-page timeline + a short acceptance checklist this week. we'll commit to a canary health update 10 days after the canary begins.

Omar (VP Eng): engineering note on API v2: surface is feature-frozen. remaining work: final kernel perf patch, quantization verification, and one security audit tweak. rollout plan: 5d shadow -> 7d canary -> 7d ramp -> opt-in -> GA if gates pass. Main risk is perf variance on long-tail queries.

Ben (Platform): Console GA constraint: tenant migration tooling + RBAC parity. plan: internal migration rehearsal late Aug, invited beta Oct, GA Nov. Ops requires rollback-tested runbook and 72h post-migration stability window for critical tenants.

Carla (Solutions): partners specifically asked for: beta vs GA feature matrix, SDK deprecation windows, and sample migration scripts. marketing also needs asset deadlines for launch plays. Product should publish a small matrix + calendar.

Leah (Head of Product): draft "targets" (provisional) for comms (will refine):
```
- API v2: shadow start ~ 2026-08-20, canary start ~ 2026-08-25, GA target ~ 2026-11-04
- Console: invited beta ~ 2026-10-05, GA target ~ 2026-11-18
- Optimize (cost recommendations): team preview ~ 2026-09-08, public beta ~ 2026-10-01
```

Omar (VP Eng): proposed acceptance gates (API v2):
- security audit closed (no P1s)
- telemetry: error rate delta < 0.2% vs baseline across canary
- perf: P99 <= 1.2x baseline, median within 1.05x
- resource: no memory growth after 96h soak
- observability: end-to-end tracing and canary dashboards green
We'll require shadow + 5d canary with automated rollback trigger if thresholds breach.

Ben (Platform): Console migration gates:
- dry-run success on 4 tenants (diverse sizes)
- rollback script validated and exercised
- runbook walkthrough + < 45m migration time per tenant in practice
- 72h post-migration monitoring with SLOs within threshold
Ops will sign off after the 72h window.

Carla (Solutions): partner comms checklist: feature-flag names, SDK changelog, deprecation window (minimum 90 days), sample migration scripts, and a 5-min migration troubleshooting clip. I'll coordinate with marketing for assets and dates.

Leah (Head of Product): action items (owners):
1) Leah -> publish one-pager timeline + public FAQ + calendar (owner)
2) Omar -> post perf/security checklist and add automated rollback triggers (owner)
3) Ben -> schedule dry-runs + publish migration runbook (owner)
4) Carla -> partner matrix + marketing asset list (owner)
I'll post links in this thread by Wednesday EOD.

ops-bot: scheduled: canary-fleet-reserve job queued for 2026-08-18 09:00 UTC.

Omar (VP Eng): small infra ask: pin driver/runtime for shadow/canary to avoid noisy perf deltas; also enable shadow traffic at 2% of real traffic to validate correctness.

Ben (Platform): will pin driver v526.10 for the window and enable 2% shadow traffic. noted.

Sophie (CEO): decision summary: publish target windows labeled "target/provisional"; provide a canary health update ~10 days after canary begins; keep this thread as the single partner-facing source and keep replies short. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
